title: Retained sets in a successive run
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\\tau$ be rational with $0<\\tau\\le 1$, and let an estimate assign a rational number to each pair consisting of a coordinate set $J$ and a subset of $J$. Suppose $k+1\\le n$, and suppose the run through step $k+1$ returns the family $A$. Then every $S\\in A$ belongs to the retained family at step $k$ for some preceding active family.
hypotheses_covered: Finite active family $A$ returned by the run through step $k+1$
